translations.web: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?
translations.bsb: For in this hope we were saved; but hope that is seen is no hope at all. Who hopes for what he can already see?
translations.kjv: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?
translations.asv: For in hope were we saved: but hope that is seen is not hope: for who hopeth for that which he seeth?
